ios.desc:
Friendly Social is an elegant companion for posting and browsing across your favorite social media networks! Access your Facebook, Messenger, Instagram, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Reddit, Snap, TikTok and other social accounts all through one powerful browser app. Friendly Social, by Sensor Tower, unlocks the potential of your social media.

One app for all your social media accounts:
- Block ads and trackers on your feed
- Save space on your device
- Preserve your battery
- Save on mobile data usage
- Easily switch between multiple accounts and networks

Take control of your privacy and enjoy an ad-free experience with our built-in ad blocker, filtering in-feed and in-video ads from Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, Reddit, TikTok, Snapchat, and YouTube. Each social media network runs in a dedicated web container for optimal privacy and control over your data:
- Friendly Privacy Shield blocks content trackers, click trackers, and social media ads
- Protect your social media accounts with FaceID, TouchID, or a passcode


Take Control of your data:
- Easily download or repost any of your photos or videos, as well as your friends
- Our advanced media player allows you to play in background, adjust speed, and use Picture-in-Picture
- Order feed by most recent
- Filter or highlight posts in your feed  by keywords

Enjoy your social media experience again with Friendly! Some of our other features include:
- Colorful themes
- Night mode
- Adjustable font size


GIVE FRIENDLY A TRY!
And don't hesitate to reach out if you need anything

CONTACT / HELP & FEEDBACK
Please use link on this page, or message us from the app help menu
